name: St. Regis Istanbul
positioning: The St. Regis Istanbul, a modernist, Art Deco-influenced hotel in the Nişantaşı district, across from Maçka Park
best_for: Travelers who want a Nişantaşı base for shopping and dining
Spa-focused stays with a hammam ritual

facts.text: The hotel is in the Nişantaşı district of Istanbul.
Its architecture is modernist and Art Deco influenced.
Maçka Park, with an outdoor playground, is directly across from the hotel.
Taksim Square in the Beyoğlu District is a leisurely walk from the hotel.
St. Regis Brasserie pairs Parisian elegance with Turkish and world flavors on its terrace, serving breakfast, dining, cocktails and afternoon tea.
Teas at St. Regis Brasserie are selected by a Tea Sommelier.
A glazed wine cellar at the entrance holds international vintages, including Turkish wines.
Iridium Spa is lit by candlelight and decorated with orchids and bonsai trees.
The spa offers a Sultan Hammam ritual inspired by Ottoman bathing rituals.
St. Regis Butler Service is available for all rooms and suites.
The multilingual concierge team wears the Les Clefs d'Or keys and can arrange a two-hour private Bosphorus cruise aboard a luxury motor yacht.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the rooms as spacious, sleek and understated, with Bosphorus and Maçka Park views.

highlights.text: The Bentley Suite is a collaboration between St. Regis and Bentley Motors.
Iridium Spa has seven treatment rooms, including a VIP room with a private hammam, a couple's room and a Thai-themed room.
Art displayed throughout the hotel includes works by international artists and pioneers of Turkish contemporary art.
The hotel's signature Misty Mary is made with raki, turnip juice and red basil.
Spago Istanbul by Wolfgang Puck serves California-inspired cuisine in a rooftop setting overlooking the Istanbul skyline.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The St. Regis Istanbul
